schema.description: An internet event in Amazon CloudWatch Internet Monitor that causes performance degradation or availability problems for impacted AWS client locations.

ClientLocation.description: The impacted location, such as a city, where clients access AWS application resources.

ASName.description: The name of the internet service provider (ISP) or network (ASN).

ASNumber.description: The Autonomous System Number (ASN) of the network at an impacted location.

City.description: The name of the city where the internet event is located.

Country.description: The name of the country where the internet event is located.

Latitude.description: The latitude where the internet event is located.

Longitude.description: The longitude where the internet event is located.

Metro.description: The metro area where the health event is located.

Subdivision.description: The subdivision location where the health event is located.

EndedAt.description: The time when the internet event ended. If the event hasn't ended yet, this value is empty.

EventArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the internet event.

EventId.description: The internally-generated identifier of an internet event.

EventStatus.description: The status of the internet event.

StartedAt.description: The time when the internet event started.
